WITH Industry_Margin_Averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Industry,
        AVG(Profits_in_Billion * 1.0 / Sales_in_Billion) AS avg_profit_margin
    FROM company
    GROUP BY Industry
)
SELECT 
    c.Name,
    c.Assets_in_Billion
FROM company c
JOIN Industry_Margin_Averages ima ON c.Industry = ima.Industry
WHERE c.Industry = 'Oil and gas'
    AND (c.Profits_in_Billion * 1.0 / c.Sales_in_Billion) > ima.avg_profit_margin

    SELECT AVG(c2.Profits_in_Billion * 1.0 / NULLIF(c2.Sales_in_Billion, 0))

    SUM(c.Profits_in_Billion * 1.0 / c.Sales_in_Billion) OVER (ORDER BY c.Market_Value_in_Billion) AS cumulative_profit_margin

JOIN company c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID

WITH avg_tenure AS (
    SELECT AVG(e.Year_working) AS avg_years
    FROM employment e
    JOIN people p ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID

        AND e.Company_ID = 15
)

    p.Name,
    p.Age,
    ROUND(e.Year_working - at.avg_years, 2) AS years_above_average
FROM people p
JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
CROSS JOIN avg_tenure at
WHERE p.Graduation_College = 'Northeastern'
    AND e.Company_ID = 15
    AND e.Year_working > at.avg_years

WITH industry_percentile AS (
    SELECT
        c."Industry",
        (
            SELECT c2."Profits_in_Billion"
            FROM "company" c2
            WHERE c2."Industry" = c."Industry"
            ORDER BY c2."Profits_in_Billion"
            LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CEIL(0.75 * COUNT(*)) - 1 FROM "company" c3 WHERE c3."Industry" = c."Industry")
        ) AS p75_profit
    FROM "company" c
    GROUP BY c."Industry"
)
SELECT
    co."Name" AS company_name,
    e."Year_working" AS total_years_worked
FROM "employment" e
JOIN "company" co ON e."Company_ID" = co."Company_ID"
JOIN industry_percentile ip ON co."Industry" = ip."Industry"

WITH user_info AS (
    SELECT Graduation_College 
    FROM people 
    WHERE People_ID = 3
),
valid_companies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT emp1.Company_ID
    FROM employment emp1
    JOIN employment emp2 ON emp1.Company_ID = emp2.Company_ID
    JOIN people p ON emp2.People_ID = p.People_ID
    CROSS JOIN user_info ui
    WHERE emp1.People_ID = 3
    AND emp2.People_ID != 3
    AND p.Graduation_College = ui.Graduation_College
),
qualifying_industries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Industry
    FROM company c
    WHERE c.Company_ID IN (SELECT Company_ID FROM valid_companies)
),
industry_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Industry,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.Company_ID IN (SELECT Company_ID FROM valid_companies) THEN c.Market_Value_in_Billion ELSE 0 END) AS qualifying_company_value,
        SUM(c.Market_Value_in_Billion) AS total_industry_value
    FROM company c
    WHERE c.Industry IN (SELECT Industry FROM qualifying_industries)
    GROUP BY c.Industry
)
SELECT 
    Industry,
    (qualifying_company_value * 100.0 / total_industry_value) AS percentage
FROM industry_metrics;

    AND e.People_ID != 2

        FROM employment e2
        WHERE e2.Company_ID = e.Company_ID
        AND e2.People_ID = 2

)
SELECT

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN bic.Company_ID IS NOT NULL THEN c1.Market_Value_in_Billion ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(c1.Market_Value_in_Billion),

    ) AS percentage_of_market_value
FROM company c1
LEFT JOIN brad_iowa_companies bic ON c1.Company_ID = bic.Company_ID
GROUP BY c1.Industry;
